summary: Full-stack testing of Sanskrit Verse Teacher completed. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass covering /api/health, /api/analyze (Devanagari + IAST happy paths, empty/>500-char validation), IPA determinism spot-check (नमः -> n̪ɐmɐhɐ), and /api/tts error paths (400 no key, 401 invalid key). Real LLM (gpt-5.6-sol via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) confirmed non-mocked: returned correct translation 'Dharma protects those who protect it.' with per-word grammar {pos:noun, tags:[nominative,singular,masculine], root:dharma}, sandhi_split ['dharmaḥ'], overall_confidence 0.99. Frontend: sample chip -> Analyze -> loading skeleton -> translation-text, ipa-line, overall-confidence 99%, 3 word-cards all rendered; script-badge switches Devanagari/IAST correctly; char-counter updates; Voice settings dialog opens, key+voice inputs saveable, key NOT persisted to localStorage (verified — only PostHog analytics present); Chant button without key triggered sonner toast 'No ElevenLabs key set — using browser voice' and tts-source-indicator flipped to 'Browser voice'. No console errors, no crashes.
ai_feature_verdicts: primary: /api/analyze LLM word-by-word Sanskrit analysis - pass - evidence: HTTP 200 in ~15-20s, translation='Dharma protects those who protect it.' / 'Dharma, when protected, protects.', overall_confidence=0.99, 3 words each with real grammar (pos=noun, tags=[nominative,singular,masculine], root=dharma), sandhi_split=['dharmaḥ'], deterministic ipa='d̪ʱɐɾmoː'. curl POST /api/analyze - skill: ai-testing-llm

IPA deterministic engine (verse-level) - pass - evidence: 'नमः' -> ipa='n̪ɐmɐhɐ' (visarga echo + full schwa retention), 'धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः' -> ipa='d̪ʱɐɾmoː ɾɐkʂɐt̪i ɾɐkʂit̪ɐhɐ', 12 pre-existing unit tests pass - skill: none (deterministic, not LLM)

/api/tts ElevenLabs error paths - pass (blocked on happy path: no real ElevenLabs key available - by design per review request) - evidence: no header -> 400 'ElevenLabs API key required'; header 'sk_fake123' -> 401 'Invalid ElevenLabs API key' - skill: ai-testing-audio (loaded conceptually; happy path intentionally out of scope)

Chant browser SpeechSynthesis fallback UI - pass - evidence: no key set -> click play-audio-btn -> sonner toast text 'No ElevenLabs key set — using browser voice' visible, tts-source-indicator text transitioned 'Browser fallback' -> 'Browser voice', no console errors (headless browser voice output is not audibly verifiable but code path executed cleanly) - skill: ai-testing-audio
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: motor MongoDB client + DB_NAME are imported/initialized but never used (spec says stateless, MongoDB unused). Consider removing the mongo_url/client/db lines to avoid confusion and startup dependency on MongoDB. Non-blocking.

server.py /api/tts: getattr(e, 'status_code', None) may miss ElevenLabs SDK exception classes that carry the status under a different attribute (e.g. e.response.status_code or e.body). Currently observed to work for 401 with 'sk_fake123', but worth verifying against real 429/422 responses. Non-blocking.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI 0.100+; consider migrating to lifespan handler. Non-blocking.

parse_analysis strips code fences only on leading '```'; a trailing '```' or 'json' between fences might not be handled in all cases. STRICT retry does hard-instruct the model to avoid fences so this is low-risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (8 tests) + /app/backend/tests/test_ipa.py (12 tests). Run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v`.
